info.title: Magna Carta API
info.description: The Magna Carta legal practice-management API. Every operation is enforced at one chokepoint (tenancy → authn → RBAC → idempotency → rate-limit); errors are RFC 9457 problem documents.

get.description: Service health — the walking-skeleton control-plane round trip.
The session user, their firm, and their effective permissions — the SPA's bootstrap call.

200.description: The session user, firm, and effective permissions

404.description: The session's firm is not reachable from this deployment, or the session user is a deactivated member of it (absent, never an existence oracle)

get.description: The firm's own usage: storage consumed (by class) and entity counts (matters by status, files, versions, folders, locations).

403.description: Authenticated, but the member lacks tools:firmUsage

404.description: The session's firm is not reachable, or the member is deactivated (absent)

get.description: What the edge sees about this caller's connection: public address, network operator, and the edge location serving the request.

200.description: The caller's connection as the edge sees it

403.description: Authenticated, but the member lacks tools:speedTest

get.description: Short-lived relay credentials used to measure packet loss. Answers 503 when relay measurement is not configured.

403.description: Authenticated, but the member lacks tools:speedTest

503.description: Relay measurement is not configured for this deployment

get.description: Registration data (RDAP, with a legacy WHOIS fallback) for a website's domain or an IP address.

200.description: The registration record for the queried domain or IP address

400.description: The query target is not a valid public domain or IP address

403.description: Authenticated, but the member lacks tools:whois

post.description: Render a potentially malicious URL in an isolated remote browser and return a static snapshot (screenshot, redirect chain, response headers, links) — no code runs in the user's browser.

200.description: Static snapshot of the rendered page

400.description: The target URL resolves to a non-public address (SSRF guard rejected it)

403.description: Authenticated, but the member lacks tools:safeBrowse

502.description: The remote browser renderer is unavailable or at capacity

post.description: Detect the encrypted format of an uploaded file (base64) and extract a hashcat-compatible recovery hash for offline password recovery. Requires explicit attestation that the requester holds the file legitimately. Nothing is stored; only a redacted audit record is written.

200.description: Detected format, hashcat-compatible hash string, and hashcat mode number

400.description: Attestation not authorised, file is not encrypted, format is unsupported, or bytes are malformed

403.description: Authenticated but the member lacks tools:decryption

post.description: Decrypt a password-protected file (PDF, ZIP, or OOXML) using the supplied key and return the decrypted bytes as base64. Requires explicit attestation that the requester holds the file legitimately. Nothing is stored; only a redacted audit record is written.

200.description: Decrypted file bytes encoded as base64, with an optional filename hint

400.description: Attestation not authorised, wrong password, file is not encrypted, format unsupported, or bytes are malformed

403.description: Authenticated but the member lacks tools:decryption

post.description: Starts an offline password-recovery job for an encrypted file (base64): extracts a hashcat-compatible hash and hands it to the recovery coordinator, which fans the search out across containers on the Cloudflare-CPU tier (or reports needsGpu for a slow key-derivation function outside that tier). Requires explicit attestation that the requester holds the file legitimately. The file is never stored; only the extracted hash reaches the coordinator.

200.description: The started job's id, recovery tier, and initial status

400.description: Attestation not authorised, file is not encrypted, format is unsupported, or bytes are malformed

403.description: Authenticated but the member lacks tools:decryption

get.description: Polls a password-recovery job's current state. On status found, the response carries result.password — surfaced once to the user who started the job (retrieval is bound to that identity; the password is purged after a retention window), then every later poll omits result. Every non-found status omits result.

200.description: The job's current status, tier, progress, and (when found) the password

403.description: Authenticated but the member lacks tools:decryption

404.description: No recovery job with that id was started by the requesting user

delete.description: Cancels a password-recovery job. A no-op if the job is already terminal (found, exhausted, needsGpu, or already cancelled) — cancel never overwrites an outcome already reached.

204.description: The job was cancelled (or was already terminal — a no-op either way)

403.description: Authenticated but the member lacks tools:decryption

post.description: Compute MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 digests of the request body in a single pass. Optionally report which algorithm matches an expected digest. Nothing is stored.

200.description: The five digests and byte size of the supplied body

403.description: Authenticated, but the member lacks tools:fileIntegrity

413.description: The body exceeds the firm's inspectable-size cap

post.description: Recompute a stored file's digests from its bytes at rest and compare the SHA-256 to the digest recorded at intake, recording the check. Returns the digests, the baseline result, and a hash receipt.

200.description: The recomputed digests, the baseline comparison, and the receipt

403.description: Authenticated, but the member lacks tools:fileIntegrity

404.description: No clean current version exists for the file

413.description: The stored file exceeds the firm's inspectable-size cap for inline verification

post.description: Identify an uploaded file's true content type from its bytes, compare it to the extension the filename claims, and recommend an extension when it is missing or wrong. Nothing is stored.

Parse an uploaded email file (.eml or .msg) and return its headers, participants, subject, message and reply identifiers, body text, described attachments, and authenticity evidence (DKIM signatures, authentication results, and the received chain) captured verbatim with no verdict. Nothing is stored.

422.description: The bytes could not be read as an email, or are not a format this tool supports

post.description: File a raw email message (.eml or .msg bytes) to this matter. The bytes are staged and the parse, dedup, thread-linking, and attachment extraction run off the request path; the response returns a job identifier. A message the firm already holds is deduped to one record and linked, never duplicated. This is the endpoint the native add-in's Save & File posts to.

202.description: Capture accepted; filing runs off the request path

404.description: Unknown matter

get.description: List the emails filed to this matter, newest first (cursor-paginated).

The wall-safe 'already filed' signal: given a Message-ID or a content hash, report whether the firm has captured it and, if so, the matters it is filed to that the caller can access plus a bare count of the rest. A caller walled from every matter it is filed to learns only that it was captured, never a matter identity. This backs the add-in's 'Already filed to {Matter}' indicator.

422.description: Neither messageId nor contentHash provided

get.description: Read one captured message with its participants and the wall-safe list of other matters it is filed to that the caller can access. A caller who can access none of the matters it is filed to receives 404 (absence, never a leak of a walled matter).

200.description: The message and its wall-safe multi-matter context

404.description: Unknown message, or one the caller cannot access

post.description: Accept a staged email link onto this matter (staged → filed). Traverses the filing-time conflict/ethical-wall hook before filing.

200.description: The link was filed (or was already filed)

404.description: No staged link for this message on this matter

delete.description: Unlink an email from this matter (the link → unlinked). Never deletes the message: it stays on any other matters it is filed to.

200.description: The link was unlinked (or was already unlinked)

post.description: Mint the firm's catch-all capture address. Mail forwarded to it is captured for the firm with no candidate matter, for staff to route. A firm holds at most one live catch-all; revoke the existing one first. The full token is returned only in this response.

201.description: The minted catch-all address, with its token shown once

409.description: The firm already holds a live catch-all address, or a request with this Idempotency-Key is still in progress

422.description: The Idempotency-Key was reused with a different payload

delete.description: Revoke the firm's catch-all capture address. Routing stops first, so mail to the old address bounces from the moment this returns. Revoking one that is already revoked succeeds.

200.description: The catch-all no longer routes (or already did not)

404.description: The firm holds no live catch-all address

post.description: Mint a forward/CC capture address for this matter. Mail forwarded or CC'd to the returned address is captured and staged onto the matter. The full token is returned only in this response — later reads show a masked form, because the token is itself the credential.

201.description: The minted address, with its token shown once

404.description: Unknown matter

409.description: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still in progress

422.description: The Idempotency-Key was reused with a different payload

get.description: List this matter's capture addresses, live and retired, newest first. Token values are never returned — each row carries a short prefix and its metadata.

post.description: Rotate a capture address: the old token stops routing and a fresh one is minted for the same matter, returned here. Use this when an address has been over-shared. Replaying the same Idempotency-Key returns the same new token rather than rotating twice.

201.description: The replacement address, with its token shown once

404.description: No live capture address with this handle on this matter

409.description: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still in progress

422.description: The Idempotency-Key was reused with a different payload

delete.description: Revoke a capture address. Routing stops first, so mail to it bounces from the moment this returns; already-captured messages are untouched. Revoking one that is already revoked succeeds.

200.description: The address no longer routes (or already did not)

404.description: No capture address with this handle on this matter

post.description: Diagnose a possibly-corrupt uploaded file: detect its format, describe the corruption, and report whether it can be repaired (and whether carving may recover embedded files). Nothing is stored.

Repair a structurally corrupted uploaded file by reconstructing its format (ZIP/OOXML, CFB/OLE2, or a PDF cross-reference), returning the salvaged file plus an honest manifest of what could not be recovered. The reconstructed output is re-scanned for malware before it is returned. Nothing is stored.

200.description: The reconstructed files and the honest loss manifest

422.description: The file could not be reconstructed, or the output was withheld by the malware gate

post.description: Carve embedded known-type files (e.g. JPEG, PNG, PDF, ZIP) out of an unrecognized or severely damaged uploaded file by scanning its raw bytes, validating each candidate by actually decoding it. Every carved file is re-scanned for malware before it is returned. Nothing is stored.

200.description: The reconstructed files and the honest loss manifest

422.description: The file could not be reconstructed, or the output was withheld by the malware gate

post.description: Repair the uploaded corrupt file and save the result into a matter: a new version of an existing file (when fileId is given) or a new file. The reconstruction rides the ingest malware gate; the honest loss manifest is stored with the version. Returns 202 — the version is pending until ingest resolves.

202.description: Attaching: the pending file/version rows and the provenance were committed and the bytes were put to R2. The version is pending until the ingest queue consumer commits or quarantines it.

404.description: The target file, or its folder, is unknown in this firm, or belongs to another matter

422.description: The file could not be reconstructed, or the output was withheld by the malware gate

post.description: Carve embedded files out of the uploaded input and save each as a new file in the matter folder. Each carved file rides the ingest malware gate and carries the honest carve manifest. Returns 202.

202.description: Attaching carved files; versions pending. Each carved file's metadata was committed and bytes were put to R2. Versions are pending until ingest resolves.

404.description: The target folder, or the matter, is unknown in this firm

422.description: The file could not be reconstructed, or the output was withheld by the malware gate

post.description: Recognize text in a scanned image or PDF. Returns per-page lines with word boxes, confidence, and the engine and model that produced them. Pages that already carry a text layer are reported as skipped rather than re-recognized. Nothing is stored.

422.description: The document is unreadable or was rejected outright — retrying will not help

post.description: Recognize a scanned PDF and return it with an invisible text layer over every scanned page, so the document becomes selectable and searchable with nothing new visible. Additive: a page that already carries a text layer is left unchanged. PDF only. Nothing is stored.

200.description: The input PDF with an invisible, searchable text layer

422.description: The document is not a PDF, is unreadable, or was rejected outright — retrying will not help

post.description: Estimate the likelihood that pasted text was machine-generated. Returns a coarse likelihood band with an explicit reliability grade and the reasons to hesitate — a signal, not proof. Requires the firm to have enabled external detection; text is sent to the configured provider and is not retained. Nothing is stored except a usage meter entry.

422.description: External detection is disabled for this firm, or detection is unavailable

502.description: The detection provider rejected the request or is unavailable

post.description: Inspect an uploaded file (base64) and report the metadata and content-bearing artifacts it carries, with a risk level per category. Nothing is stored.
Return a cleaned copy (base64) of an uploaded file with the selected metadata and content artifacts removed, plus a re-inspection of the result. Defaults to removing everything. Nothing is stored.

Invites a member into the session firm: creates the (unverified, account-less) user, enqueues the per-firm member.provision outbox row, audits the invite — one atomic batch — then sends the activation email (a password-reset link; the reset creates the credential).

201.description: The invited user, pending activation through the emailed reset link

404.description: The session's firm is not reachable from this deployment, or the session member is deactivated (absent, never an existence oracle)

409.description: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still in progress

422.description: The email is already in use, or the Idempotency-Key was reused with a different payload

put.description: Sets the session firm's release channel to stable or beta. Moving to beta requires an explicit consent acknowledgment (the firm confirms it accepts pre-release behavior on live data). Returning to stable needs no acknowledgment. Alpha is a platform-only channel and is rejected at the schema level.

200.description: The firm's release channel after the update

400.description: Missing Idempotency-Key (this operation requires one); or beta requested without consent acknowledgment

404.description: The session's firm is not reachable from this deployment, or the session member is deactivated (absent, never an existence oracle)

409.description: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still in progress

422.description: Validation failed (e.g. channel value outside the firm-accessible set); or the Idempotency-Key was reused with a different payload

post.description: Provisions a tenant firm (platform-admin only): firm row, bucket, owner user with the Owner/Admin role — resumable; re-invoking with the same name no-ops completed steps and returns the existing firm. The firm's per-firm database is the firmId-addressed database that self-migrates on first access, so it needs no provisioning step.

201.description: The provisioned (or, on an idempotent re-invoke, existing) active firm

409.description: An active firm already holds this name with a different owner, a request with this Idempotency-Key is still in progress, or a concurrent provisioning of the same name completed first (retry to observe it)

422.description: The owner email already belongs to another user, or the Idempotency-Key was reused with a different payload

post.description: Platform-admin endpoint to set any firm's release channel (including alpha). Requires the X-Platform-Admin-Key secret header. Alpha is accessible only through this platform path; the firm-admin PUT /api/v1/firm/release-channel accepts stable and beta only.

200.description: The firm's release channel after the update

404.description: No firm with the given identifier exists in the control plane

409.description: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still in progress

422.description: Validation failed (channel value outside the allowed set); or the Idempotency-Key was reused with a different payload

post.description: A platform operator declares a service event (a disruption) with an opening update.

403.description: Not a platform operator, or 2FA not enabled

422.description: Invalid body

post.description: A platform operator posts a rolling update to an existing service event.

403.description: Not a platform operator, or 2FA not enabled

404.description: No such event

422.description: Invalid body

post.description: A platform operator resolves a service event (marks it resolved with a final update).

403.description: Not a platform operator, or 2FA not enabled

404.description: No such event

422.description: Invalid body

post.description: A platform operator sets a component status override (including a maintenance window, via status maintenance), upserted by componentId.

403.description: Not a platform operator, or 2FA not enabled

422.description: Invalid body

post.description: A platform operator clears a component status override by componentId.

403.description: Not a platform operator, or 2FA not enabled

422.description: Invalid body

post.description: Files a diagnostic incident from the session firm: writes the per-firm incident row and the incident.created outbox row in one atomic batch (the diagnostics agent's future feed). Any member may report; the description is the user's words, the rest is id-and-action shaped.

404.description: The session's firm is not reachable, or the session member is deactivated — absent, never an existence oracle

422.description: The body failed validation (over-cap breadcrumbs/errorIds, empty description, …)

post.description: Begins a direct-to-R2 upload: mints the pending file/version/upload-session rows and returns either a single-shot presigned PUT (at or below the firm's mode threshold) or a multipart session (above it). The bytes never transit the Worker.

201.description: The upload was initiated; use the returned URL (PUT) or session (multipart)

404.description: The firm is unreachable, the member is deactivated, or the target file is unknown

409.description: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still in progress

422.description: The firm policy refuses this upload, or the Idempotency-Key was reused with a different payload

get.description: Reports an upload session's progress: the session status (open, completed, aborted, expired), its version's ingest status (pending, clean, quarantined, abandoned), and — when the bytes were rejected as malware — the quarantine reason. A session that belongs to another firm is 404.

404.description: No such upload session in this firm

get.description: Signs one part of an open multipart upload session, returning a short-TTL presigned PUT URL the client uploads the part to. The session must be open and multipart.

200.description: A presigned PUT URL for the requested part

404.description: No such upload session in this firm

409.description: The session is not open, or is not a multipart session

post.description: Finalizes an open upload session: completes the multipart upload at R2 (when multipart) and marks the session completed. The version stays pending until ingest commits or quarantines it.

200.description: The session was completed; the object is in R2 awaiting ingest

404.description: No such upload session in this firm

409.description: The session is not open, or a multipart completion was sent without parts

post.description: Aborts an open upload session: aborts the multipart upload at R2 (when multipart), marks the session aborted, and abandons the pending version.

200.description: The session was aborted and its pending version abandoned

404.description: No such upload session in this firm

409.description: The session is not open

post.description: Creates a matter. status 'prospective' opens an unnumbered consultation (it appears only in the responsible attorney's Consultations view); status 'open' draws the firm's next matter number atomically and opens it.

201.description: The matter was created (numbered when opened)

403.description: The session member lacks the required permission

404.description: The firm is unreachable, the member is deactivated, or the matter is unknown

409.description: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still in progress, or the matter is in the wrong state

422.description: The request is invalid, or the Idempotency-Key was reused with a different payload

get.description: Lists the firm's matters (the working caseload — Prospective consultations are excluded unless status=prospective is named), cursor-paginated, filterable by status/type/location/responsible member and a free-text search over title, number, and client.

404.description: The firm is unreachable, the member is deactivated, or the matter is unknown

get.description: The Consultations view: the session attorney's unnumbered Prospective matters, each flagged stale once it has sat past the firm's stale-consultation age. Cursor-paginated.

200.description: A page of the attorney's consultations

404.description: The firm is unreachable, the member is deactivated, or the matter is unknown

get.description: Returns one matter's detail.

404.description: The firm is unreachable, the member is deactivated, or the matter is unknown

patch.description: Updates a matter's editable fields (title, description, type, Location, responsible member, client display fields). Does not change status or the assigned number.

403.description: The session member lacks the required permission

404.description: The firm is unreachable, the member is deactivated, or the matter is unknown

409.description: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still in progress, or the matter is in the wrong state

422.description: The request is invalid, or the Idempotency-Key was reused with a different payload

post.description: Opens a Prospective matter: draws the firm's next matter number atomically and transitions it to open. Refuses a matter that is not Prospective.

200.description: The matter was opened and numbered

403.description: The session member lacks the required permission

404.description: The firm is unreachable, the member is deactivated, or the matter is unknown

409.description: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still in progress, or the matter is in the wrong state

422.description: The request is invalid, or the Idempotency-Key was reused with a different payload

403.description: The session member lacks the required permission

404.description: The firm is unreachable, the member is deactivated, or the matter is unknown

422.description: The request is invalid, or the Idempotency-Key was reused with a different payload

post.description: Reopens a closed matter, restoring its pre-close status (open if it was numbered, else Prospective). The frozen number, if any, is untouched.

403.description: The session member lacks the required permission

404.description: The firm is unreachable, the member is deactivated, or the matter is unknown

409.description: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still in progress, or the matter is in the wrong state

422.description: The request is invalid, or the Idempotency-Key was reused with a different payload

post.description: Assigns a manual/court/legacy matter number (never touches a counter). The number must be URL-safe and unique within the firm.

404.description: The firm is unreachable, the member is deactivated, or the matter is unknown

409.description: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still in progress, or the matter is in the wrong state

409.description: A request with this Idempotency-Key is in progress, or the name/code is already in use

422.description: The request is invalid, or the Idempotency-Key was reused with a different payload

404.description: The firm is unreachable, the member is deactivated, or the type is unknown

patch.description: Updates a matter type's name or code.

404.description: The firm is unreachable, the member is deactivated, or the type is unknown

409.description: A request with this Idempotency-Key is in progress, or the name/code is already in use

422.description: The request is invalid, or the Idempotency-Key was reused with a different payload

get.description: Returns one Location's detail.

404.description: The firm is unreachable, the member is deactivated, or the location is unknown

get.description: Returns the firm's active matter-numbering scheme (the ordered segment template), or null segments when none is configured yet.

200.description: The active scheme's segments, or null

404.description: The firm is unreachable or the member is deactivated

put.description: Replaces the firm's active matter-numbering scheme. The prior scheme is retained but deactivated (numbers already drawn are frozen — a scheme change affects only later matters). Rejects a scheme without exactly one counter segment.

200.description: The scheme was set; the validated segments are echoed

422.description: The scheme is invalid (not exactly one counter), or the Idempotency-Key was reused

post.description: Renders a candidate numbering scheme against a sample context and counter value, returning the example number and its derived counter scope key. Pure: it writes nothing and never touches a counter.

200.description: The rendered example number and its scope key

404.description: The firm is unreachable or the member is deactivated

422.description: The scheme is invalid, or a scoping/value segment has no value in the sample context

get.description: Lists a matter's folder tree in adjacency-list form (each node carries its parent link and name). Folders carry no clean/pending status — every folder in the matter is returned.

404.description: The firm is unreachable, the member is deactivated, or the folder/matter is unknown

post.description: Creates a folder under a matter (optionally nested under a parent folder). A folder is pure metadata — file bytes are keyed independently, so this moves nothing in storage.

404.description: The firm is unreachable, the member is deactivated, or the folder/matter is unknown

409.description: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still in progress, or the folder cannot be changed (name taken, would form a cycle, or is not empty)

422.description: The Idempotency-Key was reused with a different payload

patch.description: Renames a folder and/or moves it under a new parent (or to the matter root). Refuses a move that would form a cycle, or a name already taken among its new siblings.

409.description: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still in progress, or the folder cannot be changed (name taken, would form a cycle, or is not empty)

422.description: The Idempotency-Key was reused with a different payload

get.description: Lists a matter's files (optionally a single folder), cursor-paginated. Each row carries its display version's number, size, sniffed type, scan verdict, and status, so one call paints a file table with no per-row fan-out to the version history. By default only files with a committed clean version appear (soft-deleted files are always excluded). Set includePendingAndQuarantined=true to also surface files whose latest version is still processing (pending) or was rejected as malware (quarantined); those rows carry a null currentVersionId and cannot be downloaded.
